notes: AlloFlow starts faster in Canvas: a fifth of the app source moved into modules that load on demand, so the page you paste is 20 percent smaller. Zoom Gallery measures between two points, shows a live scale bar on images whose size is known, adds a scale challenge (estimate first, then measure) and the far side of the Moon at a measured scale. Scale Explorer opens a real photo in one click, tiles near neighbours side by side, plays the zoom as one continuous film, shows the order of magnitude, lets the student be the person on the ladder, and shares links that open at a place. SEL Hub deepened Teamwork, Virtual Team, Values Sort, Bias Check, Decision Workshop and Upstander practice, and creative, health, personal and social goals with flexible routine plans; every SEL tool's content is now wired and audited. Dino Lab gained studio-light, size-reference, fossil-tray and anatomical close-up studies with smoother motion and skin detail. Cell Explorer labels read better and select by touch. Lesson plan scripts generate and persist reliably. Kitchen Lab has a recipe engine with units, and Sourcebook speaks Spanish (Latin America). 43 illustrated AlloPacks and six crew packs for grades 6 to 8 are published. The document remediation connector reached 0.11: it examines bookmarks, forms and open actions instead of refusing them, and the keyless lane verifies fixes per engine.
